title: Open restriction of pro-etale direct image with counit normalization
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $h:W\hookrightarrow Y$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and $X_W=X\times_YW$, with projections $g:X_W\hookrightarrow X$ and $f_W:X_W\to W$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the actual inverse images and direct images [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], coefficient rings $R_X=f^{-1}R$, $R_W=h^{-1}R$ and $R_{X_W}=g^{-1}R_X\cong f_W^{-1}R_W$, and the module adjunctions $f^{-1}\dashv f_*$ and $f_W^{-1}\dashv f_{W,*}$ for these inverse-image coefficient rings [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction]. For every $R_X$-module sheaf $M$ on $X$, there is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$\beta_M:h^{-1}f_*M\xrightarrow{\sim}f_{W,*}g^{-1}M.$$
Under the open-slice identifications [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-comparison], its evaluation at $E\to W$ is the fibre-product identification $M(X\times_YE)\cong M(X_W\times_WE)$. It is compatible with the specified adjunction counits: writing $\alpha_F:g^{-1}f^{-1}F\xrightarrow{\sim}f_W^{-1}h^{-1}F$ for the canonical inverse-image comparison [lem-weil-pbc-site-morphism-composition], one has
$$g^{-1}(\varepsilon_{f,M})=\varepsilon_{f_W,g^{-1}M}\circ f_W^{-1}(\beta_M)\circ\alpha_{f_*M}.$$
No Noetherian, quasi-compactness, properness, closed-immersion, constant-ring or finiteness assumption is imposed on $f$ or $R$.
